integrity: Analytic proof plus an exhaustive exact-integer small-graph certificate; no publication-priority certification or independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Full all-graph classification is only for simple unweighted graphs with at most five vertices.
The general distance-four mechanism is a sufficient obstruction to small-step positivity, not an iff for graphs of diameter at most three.
Weighted, directed, and nonlinear/fractional PDE time-stepping contexts are not covered.
The complete text of Wade et al. (first public 2004-09-29) was not accessible; priority remains subject to specialist inspection.
title: Five-vertex and distance-four positivity barriers for Padé \([0/2]\) graph diffusion
